values: Raw-spectrum functional-group classification performance (Seed 41). Micro- and macro-averaged F1 scores and pure model-fit times are reported for all models. Best F1 results per modality and metric are highlighted.
Native input: C-NMR, H-NMR and MS/MS = 10,000 values; IR = 1,800 values. External preprocessing: none. Model-internal normalization remains unchanged.
Training: Seed 41; up to 1,000,000 epochs/estimators; early-stopping patience 15. TTN uses stride 44 only for the 10,000-point native inputs. Training time is pure model-fit time in minutes.
